findings.summary: d3a1fef splits delayed swings from zero-delay structure and retains machine-readable known_at, source bars and lag in validated overlay packets.
Equal-price pivot tie policy is implicit/asymmetric and lacks parity fixtures.
No Pine plot-offset/backfill replay fixture proves visibility begins at known_at.
No alert fixture covers same-bar versus close-only delivery, saved inputs and reconnect dedupe.
No MQL CopyRates/iBarShift order and missing-gap corpus is compared to the canonical mapper.
OB, CHoCH/MSS, liquidity and OTE are vocabulary/adapter declarations here, not lifecycle detectors in this slice.
C2 inclusive close equality is causal but differs by one lower bar from Pine expression[1]+lookahead_on boundary timing; boundary mode must be explicit for byte-for-byte parity.

Legacy MT5Gateway HandleGetData overwrites the newest CopyRates row with current bid/high/low, emits bar-open time without a closed marker, and falls back unknown timeframe strings to PERIOD_CURRENT; direct ChartBar ingestion is unsafe.
Committed CHoCH normalization and LIQUIDITY_SWEEP allow-list support in 666e8da; positive alert tests cover both kinds.
